race.comment: KIRRIBILLI (8) has progressed nicely in three runs since a brief spell. Looked a chance last start over 1250m at the Kensington circuit but couldn't quicken under the 59kgs. Drops to 56kgs with the claim today and will be cherry ripe now. Great chance to break a win drought of almost a year. REGAL PROBLEM (2) is a progressive mare who has saluted at both runs this prep, the latest over 1250m at the Kenso where she powered through the line. Getting up to 61kgs is the niggle but she can improve further at this stage of the prep. LIVE (10) came from last on the bend and finished just 1.1 lengths behind REGAL PROBLEM when fresh from a spell recently. Meets her 3kgs better and strips fitter so she is right in this. TITANIUM MISS (1) gave REGAL PROBLEM a scare two back then failed at stakes level. In the picture. Import ERTIJAAJ (17) resumes. Made a big impression at the start of last prep - expect her to be ready for another big first-up performance.
